coach_labels: Keep these pointers in mind: Your back foot isn't lifting properly, your hips aren't rotating, and your arms are too tense. Your body needs to relax more, which is preventing your shoulders from freely exchanging movement side to side. Also, your stance has your center of gravity too high.
When throwing a punch, keep your body from lunging forward.
You're using only arm strength, and your upper body and arms are too tense without any hip rotation. Also, your legs aren't in a half-squat position.
